notify.doc: Broadcast signaling data to a list of hub recipients, excluding the sender socket. Iterates each hub ID in the recipients array, fetches all entity sockets for that hub excluding the provided socket_id, and sends the full input payload to each via RedisStore.

recipients.description: Array of hub IDs to broadcast the signaling data to. Each hub's entity sockets are resolved and notified.

socket_id.description: Socket ID of the sender to exclude from recipients

returns.description: Full input data payload echoed back after broadcast

message.doc: Broadcast a signaling message to target peers and optionally log a call event. Resolves recipients from the target object set during initialization: socket-scoped (target.socket_id or target.stream_id), hub-scoped (target.hub_id), or user-scoped (target.uid). After sending via RedisStore, attempts to log the call event in chat history if the role is 'caller' and type is cancel, leave, or reject.

target.description: Target recipient descriptor resolved during initialization. Can contain socket_id or stream_id (socket scope), hub_id (hub scope), or uid (user scope).

origin.description: Origin sender descriptor merged with authenticated user profile (uid, firstname, lastname, fullname, email) during initialization.

scope.description: Explicit dispatch scope override: 'socket', 'hub', or 'user'. Inferred from target fields if omitted.

type.description: Signal type used for call event logging (e.g. 'cancel', 'leave', 'reject'). Only triggers log when role is 'caller'.

role.description: Caller role for event logging. Set to 'caller' to trigger call history logging.

duration.description: Call duration in seconds for call event logging

returns.description: Full input data payload echoed back after broadcast

dial.doc: Initiate a call to a target user by sending an INCOMING_CALL signal to all their connected sockets. Resolves the target user's sockets via user_sockets, creates a room_invite_next entry for each socket as a listener, and sends the call payload via RedisStore. Returns offline indicator if the target user has no active sockets. Self-calling is explicitly rejected.

target.description: Target user descriptor resolved during initialization. Must contain uid of the user to call.

room_id.description: Room ID for the call session. Used as the room_id and nid in the INCOMING_CALL payload.

room_type.description: Type of the call room (e.g. meeting, screen)

device_id.description: Device ID of the caller, included in the room_invite_next entry for each target socket

returns.description: Full input data with origin and target fields on success, or offline indicator if target has no active sockets

offline.description: Present with value 1 when the target user has no active socket connections

origin.description: Caller origin descriptor with uid and profile fields

room_id.description: Room ID of the initiated call

errors.message: The target uid matches the caller's own uid or ident
